title: anybody here who dreams about pets while in mallworld?
content: I often dream about normal life in mallworld and I own pets there. have to cats in real live and they sometimes follow me into my mallworld dreams. there is also a third cat I only know in my dreams, which I know belongs to me somehow in this strange dreamworld. last week I had a golden retriever join me in mallworld. he followed me through my mallworld day. and when I was a child I often dreamt about having and travelling with guinea pigs and rabbits. I always wonder why I dream about animals/pets there. I never owned s dog or rabbits. can someone here relate?
